fragments.text: Rebuild the full supplied scene as one portrait 3:4 handmade tape picture, keeping the kiosk and bicycle as its clear focus.
Construct every pictorial surface from torn washi or masking-tape pieces; do not leave an intact photographic layer beneath decorative strips.
Sample mustard yellow, deep green, sea blue and cloud white from the photograph, using matte paper versions of those colors.
Show uneven torn ends, delicate fibers and slight translucency; overlapped tape creates subtle darker color intersections.
Align long strips with walls, roof edges and the horizon; use smaller torn pieces for foliage, clouds and bicycle structure.
Keep door, window, wheels, frame and plant placement identifiable; simplify spokes without merging or breaking the bicycle’s connections.
Use shallow contact shadows between paper layers only; preserve an overall flat handmade picture rather than a deep sculptural diorama.
Let outer tape edges end naturally on clean white backing; add no typography, brand marks, exterior frame or watermark.

fragmentsZh: 把完整原景重构为3:4竖版手工胶带画，小亭和单车仍为清楚焦点。
所有图像表面都由撕裂和纸或美纹胶带拼成，不能在完整照片上仅贴装饰胶带。
从照片取芥末黄、深绿、海蓝和云白，转为对应哑光纸色。
显出不齐撕口、细纤维和轻微透明度，胶带交叠形成自然略深色交叉。
长胶带顺墙面、屋檐和海平线排列，植被、云和单车结构使用较小撕片。
门窗、车轮、车架和盆栽位置可辨，简化辐条但不合并或断开单车结构。
纸层间仅用浅接触影，整体仍为平面手工作品，不变成深立体沙盘。
外沿胶带自然结束在干净白底纸上，不加文字、品牌、外框或水印。
